assumptions: DHL tagesschni is treated as mean parcels per operating day, following existing HAGRID/PANDA usage; measurement definition unconfirmed.
DHL rows are additive within PLZ, following PANDA; repeated street records remain a flagged uncertainty.
Hermes is used only for within-training spatial shape, not absolute units.
Historical source population and firms are used as reference-year proxies; their actual vintages remain unconfirmed.
313 reference operating days, calendar weights, spatial and daily noise parameters are explicit assumptions.
Legacy market/B2B/volume series are inherited priors and projection paths, not new independent observations.
National relative volume growth is provisionally transferred to the region. No building-level future stock changes are invented.
An empty holiday list means weekday/month seasonality only; no official holiday calendar has been supplied.
No exact PANDA reproduction: original OSM/Zensus caches are unavailable in the review clone.
Seasonality uses the inherited Swiss 2019-2021 weekly mean profile. Week 53 interpolates weeks 52 and 1; monthly weights are neutral.
Weekly and annual correlated shocks are user-adjustable assumptions, not fitted uncertainty.
Square-root business exposure chosen from exploratory repeated postal CV after prior test inspection. New split metrics are not an untouched confirmation.
User-defined CEP scope: exclude entire DHL street observations above 1000 before aggregation; this does not establish the observed transport mode.
